description: Test observation: each named test maps to success or an assertion failure. Success requires equality against independent window enumeration or materialized-and-sorted rotations plus literal boundary expectations. The finite suite covers only its stated domains; it is not the production function's entire domain.
state: Finite byte slices, exact ordered byte offsets or canonical cyclic index; tests observe assertions.
cost: O(n) comparisons/time, O(1) auxiliary storage and no allocation. After a mismatch, matched+1 candidates are eliminated and one candidate advances by that amount; equal comparisons are charged to the following advance or final n-match tie. No doubled string or 2*n arithmetic is used.
forward: For bytes s, return the smallest i among all indices whose rotation s[i..]+s[..i] is lexicographically minimal. Return 0 for the empty slice.
inverse: For observed i retain all strings for which rotation i is minimal and no earlier index ties it; i=0 additionally admits empty input. abc and xyz both map to zero. Positive output does not determine length, alphabet, period, or bytes. Complete fiber enumeration is not implemented.
checks: Independent bounded oracle, boundary fixtures, repeated debug/release, compiled negative controls; see model.md#tests
limitations: Finite evidence is not proof; partial syntax omits expansion and semantic resolution; allocation failure is not modeled.
